notes: T770 — task-ID mint must consult archive. DEFECT (found live 2026-08-23 during T759): four rows (T761–T763, T765) were retired minutes after registration, and the next `managent add --auto` minted T765 AGAIN — a live row colliding with the archived T765 in docs/infra/managent/archive.json. Root cause: cmdAdd's auto path minted `T{sys_next_id}` where sys_next_id lives in tasks.json `_sys.next_id` — a DIFFERENT file from the archive. The T204 parseStateJson guard raises next_id above the LIVE max only; a retired id is invisible to it (and a stale store rollback drops next_id back below the archive max). A retired id is a reference forever; re-minting it silently rebinds every citation of the retired row. Same family as T758 (directive-ID mint from ledger max); this is the task-ID instance. FIX (test-first, red→green; T758's fix is the template): (a) mint from max(next_id, live-max+1, archive-max+1) — cmdAdd auto (main.zig:3084) and cmdSuggest (main.zig:3685) now compute `@max(sys_next_id, maxArchivedTaskId(archive_path)+1)` and write back next_id = mint_base+1; (b) backstop — cmdAdd's explicit path (main.zig:3199) now refuses an id already in archive.json, naming the archive (previously it checked live only, so a freed-by-retirement id could register over an archived row). New helpers: archivePath (main.zig:7675), maxArchivedTaskId (main.zig:7687), archiveContains (main.zig:7706) — all three read the RAW archive file directly, NOT readState, because parseStateJson has the side effect of reloading the _sys.* globals (sys_next_id etc.) from whatever file it parses; an archive read via readState would clobber the live counter with the archive's stale one. RED recorded against the pre-fix binary (bin/managent built 2026-08-23T14:42:20Z): arm 2 (retire top row T9001 + roll next_id back to 9001 → add --auto) minted T9001 over the archived T9001 (live T-ids ['T9000','T9001'], archive ['T9001']); arm 3 (explicit `add T9001`) refused only via the live check with the bare 'already exists' message, NOT naming the archive. GREEN against the fixed binary (bin/managent built 2026-08-23T15:48:18Z): tools/regression-task-id-archive.sh all three arms pass — null (sequential mints T9000,T9001, next_id 9002 unchanged) · retire-top-row+stale-counter mints T9002 (> archived T9001), retired id not re-minted · explicit `add T9001` refused (rc=1) naming docs/infra/managent/archive.json, refused row not registered. Wired into `zig build test` (build.zig, task_id_archive_regression step, placed beside the T758 directive-id step) — the step runs and passes under the gate (log: `=== regression-task-id-archive: ALL CONTROLS PASSED ===`). Test-first per AGENTS.md §Tooling: the failing test was written and shown RED before the fix landed.
